object_description: low-rise cluster of terraced volumes arranged around a courtyard
design_condition: The interventions largely preserve the existing arrangement, place new volumes around the courtyard, and use an offset to form an entrance space while leaving the hard-court solution unresolved.

positive.statement: The offset creates a beautifully landscaped entrance area to the main building.
The single-story terraced-house type is advantageous for this task.
Unbundling the classes into their own units and entrances solves important organizational problems.
The row of class units is harmonious and very functional.
The internal organization solves the teachers' safety aspect.
The solution allows units to be combined, decoupled, or connected and promises great flexibility.
The multi-purpose room is beautifully located facing the courtyard and has an attractive area facing the lake.

negative.statement: The extraordinary spiral staircase is clearly a scale error because there are no representative rooms on the upper floor.
The office assigned to the multi-purpose room is placed at the wrong end of the building.
The hall roof is irritating in relation to the existing building and reflects another scale error.
The teachers' room is not in the immediate vicinity of the classrooms and the distances are too long.
The peripheral location of the economic building is not quite optimal and the route concept needs refinement.
The open-space project is presented very schematically and leaves many topics unaddressed.
The courtyard design does not meet the requirements of the hard-court surface.
